Portfolio

One group. Distinct companies. Clear roles.

The brand a customer recognises is rarely the name of the legal entity. We keep the difference visible.

01 Brand architecture

Four things worth separating.

Not every venture needs every layer. Some operating companies sit directly under Accelity Partners.

Parent company
Accelity Partners — the venture-building and holding company.
Sector holding platform
Used where it is relevant to the group structure, not created to fill a navigation group.
Operating company
The entity responsible for running the business.
Market-facing brand
The identity customers know and use.

We use the verified company tree. We do not create extra entities through design or shorthand.

02 Relationships

A parent endorsement, not a visual takeover.

Each venture retains the identity that serves its audience. We apply an endorsement only once the relationship is verified and approved, and we use the wording that matches it.

An Accelity Partners company
An owned venture. The venture remains the lead identity.
In partnership with Accelity Partners
A strategic relationship, described as agreed. It does not imply ownership or control.
Advised by Accelity Partners
An advisory engagement, named only with the client's approval.

We never present an advisory client as a portfolio company.

03 Our ventures

Ventures are published once they are verified.

No venture profile has completed publication review yet.

A venture appears here only when its release permission covers a public audience, the exact wording has been approved, and its operating stage and relationship to the group have been verified. Nothing on this page is a count of the group's companies.

Looking for a particular business?

If you are trying to reach a specific venture, or you want to discuss a partnership at group level, tell us which and we will route it.
